description.en: Original simplified Charnia masoni fossil-form study informed by Dunn et al2019 Fig1F, explicitly identified BGS GSM105873 latex mould. Not exact specimen facsimile or scan. Genus-level scientific affinity uncertain; institutional Animalia catalog grouping is not settled phylogeny. Illustrative fossil length0.21m and slab0.12x0.26x0.012m, not measured dimensions of BGS specimen. Actual fossil relief and preservation do not establish living tissue thickness, color, posture or unseen rear face. Slab underside is artistic rock, not organism underside. Holotype conflict resolved for this asset by NOT selecting holotype: paper LEIUG2328 and GB3D SM A48259 catalog identities are not equated and neither is the modeled specific reference.
